scope: Bounded BC seed confirmation and frozen-Motus critic-to-policy signal diagnosis; native adaptation, no official RECAP equivalence claim
head_data: Same frozen original Motus image+instruction+q prefix features, width4096; success/failure binary MC targets, no clock, no action suffix, no terminal head target. Each task16000 sampled decisions per head seed. Shared batches16+16, independent32. Same per-task sample streams; budgets are1000 shared updates versus500 per independent head.
capacity_control: Shared h63=266367 parameters, independent2xh63=532734 total, shared h128=532737; frozen common backbone excluded
actor_extraction: Explicit exposure-matched diagnostic: fixed balanced2A+2B success/failure candidate stream; rank one-chunk TD advantages per task and retain top64 scheduled draws per task, stable draw-index tie break. Draw weights frozen before actor updates. Ordinary FM prompt, no guidance dropout; weighted loss divided by full batch. This differs from original RECAP dataset-global quantile/CFG extraction.
shuffle: Permute shared draw weights once within task/exact instruction/success/chunk-length strata, preserving actual supervision counts and action-time exposure; do not change rewards/MC targets
success_matched: Same candidate/noise/time stream, fixed seeded selection of64 successful draws per task; physical-action length/outcome composition reported separately
actor_initialization: All signal groups start from exact original Motus plus common seed0 zero-output addon; never use W1 or a BC-updated actor as an unmatched initialization
evaluation: Fixed final128 only, original12 development scenes per task, same noise and checker, no checkpoint selection
actor_gate: Require data/identity/finite/terminal/exposure audits and at least10 changed shuffled draw weights; no critic-MSE or positive-gain gate. Never tune budgets/thresholds on evaluation.
